mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.slug, t.display_name, t.status, t.default_language, t.timezone, t.db_host, t.db_port, t.db_name, t.db_owner_username AS owner_username, t.db_owner_password_enc AS owner_password_enc, t.db_app_username AS app_username, t.db_app_password_enc AS app_password_enc FROM tenants t
mapper.select: JOIN tenant_domains d ON d.tenant_id = t.id WHERE d.hostname = #{host}
SELECT hostname FROM tenant_domains WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_primary
SELECT hostname FROM tenant_domains WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY hostname
SELECT id, hostname, is_primary AS primary, tls_status, created_at FROM tenant_domains WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY is_primary DESC, hostname
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_domains WHERE hostname = #{hostname})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_domains (id, tenant_id, hostname, is_primary, tls_status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{hostname}, false, 'PENDING', #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_domains SET is_primary = false WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_primary
UPDATE tenant_domains SET is_primary = true WHERE id = #{domainId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.hostname FROM tenant_domains d JOIN tenants t ON t.id = d.tenant_id WHERE t.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED') ORDER BY d.hostname
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_domains SET tls_status = #{status} WHERE hostname = #{hostname} AND tls_status <> #{status}
